data_description.confirmation_seconds: Seconds the new room must stay the best match before switching (0 = immediate).
data_description.unknown_timeout: Seconds without any valid proxy before the position becomes unknown (0 = never).
data_description.max_distance: Distances at or above this are ignored; an unseen proxy is treated as being at this distance.
data_description.top_k: Number of most similar vertices used to pick the room and compute the coordinates.
data_description.min_common_proxies: Proxies the current reading and a vertex must share for the vertex to be considered.

save_vertex.name: Save vertex
save_vertex.description: Save a reference point (fingerprint) in the map with manually provided distances.

vertex_id.name: Vertex ID
vertex_id.description: Unique point identifier within the room (overwritten if it exists).

distances.name: Distances
distances.description: Map of distance sensor → measured meters at this point.

record_vertex.name: Record vertex
record_vertex.description: Read the device's current distances (median over the given duration) and save them as a vertex. Stand still at the point while recording.

vertex_id.name: Vertex ID
vertex_id.description: Unique point identifier within the room (overwritten if it exists).

entity_id.name: Position sensor
entity_id.description: BLE Fingerprint sensor to read the distances from (only needed if you have more than one).

delete_vertex.name: Delete vertex
delete_vertex.description: Delete a vertex from the map.

vertex_id.name: Vertex ID
vertex_id.description: Identifier of the vertex to delete.

delete_room.name: Delete room
delete_room.description: Delete a room and all of its vertices from the map.

get_map.name: Get map
get_map.description: Return the saved map (rooms, vertices, distances and coordinates).
